title: Stable influence polynomial
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set with probability mass function $\pi$, and let $B$ be an orthonormal basis of real-valued functions on $\Omega$ for the $\pi$-weighted inner product, with one basis vector equal to the constant-one function. Let its index set be finite and nonempty, and let $f\colon\Omega^n\to\mathbb{R}$, $i$ be a coordinate, and $\rho\in\mathbb{R}$. The stable influence polynomial at $i$ is the sum over multi-indices $a$ whose entry at $i$ is not the constant-vector index, of $\rho^{|a|-1}\widehat f(a)^2$, where $|a|$ is the order of $a$ and $\widehat f(a)$ is the Fourier coefficient of $f$ in the product basis.
hypotheses_covered: basis is orthonormal for the $\pi$-weighted inner product
